Thank you for your contribution and for the time you spent on it!

After discussion, we have decided not to move forward with this change. It doesn't fit our current product direction, or we are not able to take on the maintenance it would need. As explained in our [contributing guide](https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-android/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#etiquette), features always need maintenance, so we can't accept every contribution.

A maintainer may add more context in a comment below. Thanks for your understanding.
